title: Compact decision deltas protocol and replay hooks for routing observability
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: routing decision traces and per-hop provenance messages are rich but often highly redundant between hops for a single request. Current capture format stores full decision frames per hop which inflates storage and makes realtime streaming to the console and downstream analysis (replays, diffs, cost attribution) expensive. We need a compact, forward-compatible encoding that captures the minimal deltas between hop decisions plus a replay hook API so engineers and SREs can reconstruct the full decision timeline for debugging and post-incident RCA.
background_and_rationale: Observability team has repeatedly flagged two recurring issues: (1) high egress and long ingestion times for routing traces when traffic spikes, and (2) difficulty in performing cheap "what changed" queries across hops (e.g., region change, tier downgrade, variant fallback). Compact decision deltas reduce per-request payloads by 5x-10x in our sampling tests and make streamed UI updates snappier. A replay hook lets the Console fetch a lightweight summary first and request full repro only on-demand.
proposal_summary: 1) Define a compact decision delta protocol (CDDP) that encodes: stable context ids, changed fields, policy rationale hash, and optional short provenance blobs. 2) Implement server-side delta encoder at the router layer and a decoder in the console/replay service. 3) Add a /replay endpoint that accepts a decision_id and sampling token to fetch the full reconstructed decision timeline. 4) Add adaptive sampling rules so full decision capture is retained for P0 customers, error cases, and a small percentage of normal traffic.
tradeoffs_and_considerations:
- Compact deltas reduce storage and network cost but add encoding/decoding CPU overhead at the router; we measured ~2% extra CPU at 99th percentile in synthetic load.
- Backwards compatibility: unchanged consumers must be able to accept a delta envelope; plan is to keep a 'full_payload' flag when delta encoding is disabled.
- Security: deltas still contain routing metadata that may be sensitive; we will redact customer identifiers and respect existing PII filters.
- Retention: store both delta stream for all sampled requests and occasional full snapshots to support long-tail queries and legal retention requirements.
acceptance_criteria:
- CDDP schema documented and published in the internal Confluence doc.
- Router emits delta-encoded decision frames for >= 90% of sampled non-error requests in the staging cluster.
- Console can reconstruct a decision timeline via the /replay endpoint with identical semantics to the prior full-frame reconstruction for 99% of test cases.
- End-to-end storage cost for routing telemetry in staging falls by at least 40% compared to baseline.
- Unit and integration tests covering encoder/decoder and the replay flow are merged.
- Feature flag exists to toggle delta encoding per-cluster and per-customer.
implementation_steps:
1) Draft CDDP schema and get design review (owner: Markus). 2) Prototype encoder in router v2 and measure CPU/latency (owner: Eng-Infra). 3) Implement decoder and /replay API in obs-replay service (owner: obs-team). 4) Integrate adaptive sampling config and retention policy (owner: telemetry). 5) End-to-end tests, performance benchmark, and runbook updates (owner: SRE). 6) Gradual rollout behind feature flag, validate in staging, then canary to 10% prod.
Links: design doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ROUT/CDDP+Design; prototype PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing/pull/1829
risks_and_mitigations:
- Risk: Decoder mismatch causing failed replays. Mitigation: schema versioning and automatic fallback to full payload when mismatch detected.
- Risk: Increased router CPU during high QPS. Mitigation: add fast-path no-op encoding when delta savings are below threshold; autoscale router pool.
- Risk: Missed critical events due to sampling. Mitigation: deterministic sampling for errors and high-severity customers, plus on-demand full capture via customer support flow.
monitoring_and_metrics:
- Metric: delta_encode_rate (per-cluster)
- Metric: avg_delta_payload_bytes and p95_delta_payload_bytes
- Metric: replay_success_rate and replay_latency_ms
- Alert: replay_success_rate < 99% for 5m
- Dashboard: routing/deltas/ingestion-cost vs baseline (console-telemetry dashboard)
rollout_plan: Phase 0: design + prototype (2 weeks). Phase 1: staging encoder + decoder, validate savings (1 week). Phase 2: feature-flagged canary (10% prod) + monitoring (2 weeks). Phase 3: full rollout and retention optimization (1-2 weeks). Rollback: flip off delta flag; replay endpoint stays available for full payload retrieval.
